```{r}
# convert to bigrams, remove numbers, remove 

alpha_only_pattern <- r"(^[a-z]+$)"  # kills numbers, punctuation, mixed tokens

process_bigram_batch <- function(batch) {
  batch |>
    unnest_tokens(bigram, text, token = "ngrams", n = 2) |>
    separate(bigram, into = c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ") |>
    mutate(
      word1 = lemmatize_words(word1),
      word2 = lemmatize_words(word2)
    ) |>
    filter(
      str_detect(word1, alpha_only_pattern),
      str_detect(word2, alpha_only_pattern),
      !word1 %in% stop_words$word,
      !word2 %in% stop_words$word
    ) |>
    unite(bigram, word1, word2, sep = " ") |>
    count(file_name, bigram, name = "n")
}

# splits row indices into groups so that each group's total nchar stays
# under char_budget. a single row longer than char_budget gets its own
# solo batch rather than being dropped or blowing the budget for its group.
make_char_batches <- function(char_counts, char_budget) {
  batch_id <- integer(length(char_counts))
  current_batch <- 1L
  running_total <- 0L
  
  for (i in seq_along(char_counts)) {
    this_len <- char_counts[i]
    if (running_total > 0 && running_total + this_len > char_budget) {
      current_batch <- current_batch + 1L
      running_total <- 0L
    }
    batch_id[i] <- current_batch
    running_total <- running_total + this_len
  }
  
  batch_id
}

clean_dataset_bigrams <- function(ds_num, data, char_budget = 5e6) {
  out_file <- file.path(
    "/Volumes/Thesis/Epstein_Files/output/dtm_prep",
    paste0("dataset_", ds_num, "_bigram_counts.rds")
  )
  if (file.exists(out_file)) {
    message("  [SKIP] dataset ", ds_num, " already processed")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  chunk <- data |> filter(dataset == ds_num)
  chunk$char_len <- nchar(chunk$text)
  chunk$batch_id <- make_char_batches(chunk$char_len, char_budget)
  
  n_batches <- max(chunk$batch_id)
  message("  [BATCHING] dataset ", ds_num, ": ", nrow(chunk), " rows, ",
          "char_budget = ", format(char_budget, scientific = FALSE),
          ", ", n_batches, " batches")
  
  batch_results <- vector("list", n_batches)
  
  for (b in seq_len(n_batches)) {
    batch <- chunk[chunk$batch_id == b, ]
    batch_results[[b]] <- process_bigram_batch(batch)
    
    rm(batch); gc()
    if (b %% 10 == 0) message("    batch ", b, "/", n_batches, " done")
  }
  
  bigram_counts <- bind_rows(batch_results) |>
    count(file_name, bigram, wt = n, name = "n")
  
  write_rds(bigram_counts, out_file, compress = "gz")
  rm(chunk, batch_results, bigram_counts); gc()
  message("  [DONE] dataset ", ds_num)
}

for (i in 1:12) clean_dataset_bigrams(i, data)
```

```{r}
all_bigram_counts <- list.files(
  "/Volumes/Thesis/Epstein_Files/output/dtm_prep",
  pattern = "bigram_counts\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE
) |>
  map(read_rds) |>
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
term_doc_freq <- all_bigram_counts |> distinct(file_name, bigram) |> count(bigram, name = "doc_freq")

# inspect the distribution before picking a cutoff
term_doc_freq |> summarize(
  n_terms = n(),
  n_hapax = sum(doc_freq == 1),
  pct_hapax = mean(doc_freq == 1)
)
```

```{r}
tibble(threshold = c(50, 75, 100, 150, 200)) |>
  mutate(n_terms_kept = map_int(threshold, ~ sum(term_doc_freq$doc_freq >= .x)))
```

```{r}
n_docs <- n_distinct(all_bigram_counts$file_name)

term_doc_freq |>
  mutate(doc_pct = doc_freq / n_docs) |>
  arrange(desc(doc_pct)) |>
  slice_head(n = 20)
```

```{r}
keep_terms <- term_doc_freq |>
  mutate(doc_pct = doc_freq / n_docs) |>
  filter(doc_freq >= 100, doc_pct <= 0.3) |>  # adjust upper bound based on what you see
  pull(bigram)

length(keep_terms)
```

```{r}
term_doc_freq |>
  mutate(doc_pct = doc_freq / n_docs) |>
  arrange(desc(doc_pct)) |>
  slice(21:60)
```

```{r}
structural_words <- c(
  # plist/xml artifacts
  "xml", "plist", "dtd", "dtds", "doctype", "propertylist", "dict", "key", "array",
  "integer", "string", "flag", "apple", "public",
  # email header/timestamp artifacts
  "date", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat", "sun", "sit", "send",
  "monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "subject", "begin",
  "forward", "conversation", "pm", "am", "gmail", "remote", "id", "receive",
  "view", "write", "original", "message", "encode", "utf",
  # disclaimer boilerplate (second half)
  "confidential", "pursuant", "intend", "recipient"
)

boilerplate_bigrams <- c(
  "strictly prohibit", "copy thereof", "attorney client", "client privilege",
  "inside information", "constitute inside", "thereof include",
  "attachment copyright", "epstein unauthorized", "jee unauthorized",
  "treatment request", "confidential treatment"
)

keep_terms <- term_doc_freq |>
  filter(doc_freq >= 100) |>
  filter(nchar(bigram) <= 25) |>   # drops run-together/repeated-char garbage
  filter(!str_detect(bigram, paste0("\\b(", paste(structural_words, collapse = "|"), ")\\b"))) |>
  filter(!bigram %in% boilerplate_bigrams) |>
  pull(bigram)

length(keep_terms)
```

```{r}
dtm <- all_bigram_counts |>
  filter(bigram %in% keep_terms) |>
  cast_dtm(document = file_name, term = bigram, value = n)

dtm
```

Trial Run

```{r}
set.seed(1)
sample_files <- all_bigram_counts |>
  distinct(file_name) |>
  filter(file_name %in% dtm$dimnames$Docs) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 0.05) |>
  pull(file_name)

dtm_sample <- all_bigram_counts |>
  filter(bigram %in% keep_terms, file_name %in% sample_files) |>
  cast_dtm(document = file_name, term = bigram, value = n)

dtm_sample

library(topicmodels)

lda_sample <- LDA(dtm_sample, k = 12, method = "VEM", control = list(seed = 1234))
terms(lda_sample, 10)
```

```{r}
lda_model <- LDA(dtm, k = 12, method = "VEM", control = list(seed = 1234))
write_rds(lda_model, "/Volumes/Thesis/Epstein_Files/output/lda_model_k12.rds")
```

```{r}
chapter_topics <- tidy(lda_model)
chapter_topics
```

```{r}
top_terms <- chapter_topics |>
  group_by(topic) |>
  slice_max(beta, n = 5) |> 
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(topic, desc(beta))

top_terms
```

```{r}
for (t in sort(unique(top_terms$topic))) {
  p <- top_terms |>
    filter(topic == t) |>
    ggplot(aes(beta, fct_reorder(term, beta))) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "beta", y = NULL, title = paste0("Topic ", t))
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("/Volumes/Thesis/plots", paste0("topic_", t, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )
}
```
